Name: Bleeding
Desc: Take 1 damage at the start of your turn (ignores Block).

Name: Sick
Desc: Take 2 damage at the start of your turn (ignores Block).

Name: Burn
Desc: Take 1 now and 1 at the start of each of your turns.

Name: Freeze
Desc: Lose your next turn and gain no Block that turn.

Name: Cuffed
Desc: Draw 1 fewer card at the start of your turns.
